// Assessment-only actual shared-renderer fixture. No app data or saved state.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/ui/form"
	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/apps/gallery"
)

type expected struct {
	Value     string  `json:"value"`
	Submitted *string `json:"submitted"`
	Valid     bool    `json:"valid"`
	Prompt    string  `json:"prompt"`
}

type specimen struct {
	ID       string   `json:"id"`
	Light    string   `json:"htmlLight"`
	Dark     string   `json:"htmlDark"`
	Expected expected `json:"expected"`
}

func stringPtr(s string) *string { return &s }

func page(theme string, in form.Select) string {
	field := form.RenderField(form.Field{
		Label: "Delivery schedule", For: in.ID, Required: in.Required,
		Help:    "This synthetic schedule has changed. Review an available choice before submitting.",
		Control: template.HTML(form.RenderSelect(in)),
	})
	return `<!doctype html><html lang="en" data-theme="` + theme + `"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Select state fixture</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/app.css"></head><body class="bg-surface-sunken font-sans text-ink"><main class="mx-auto max-w-5xl p-4 sm:p-8"><h1 class="text-2xl font-semibold">Review delivery schedule</h1><p class="mt-3 text-sm text-ink-muted">Synthetic form submission only. No settings are saved.</p><form class="mt-8 flex flex-col gap-4" action="/saved" method="get">` +
		field + `<div class="flex gap-4">` + form.RenderButton(form.Button{Label: "Save", Type: "submit"}) +
		form.RenderButton(form.Button{Label: "Reset", Type: "reset", Variant: form.ButtonGhost}) +
		`</div></form></main></body></html>`
}

func main() {
	base := form.Select{ID: "cadence", Name: "cadence", Value: "retired", Required: true, HasHelp: true,
		Options: []form.Option{{Value: "daily", Label: "Daily digest"}, {Value: "weekly", Label: "Weekly digest"}}}
	cases := []specimen{}
	add := func(id string, in form.Select, want expected) {
		cases = append(cases, specimen{ID: id, Light: page("light", in), Dark: page("dark", in), Expected: want})
	}
	add("missing-required", base, expected{Prompt: "Selection unavailable"})
	custom := base
	custom.Placeholder = "Choose cadence"
	add("missing-custom", custom, expected{Prompt: "Choose cadence"})
	optional := base
	optional.Required = false
	add("missing-optional", optional, expected{Valid: true, Prompt: "Selection unavailable"})
	empty := custom
	empty.Value = ""
	empty.Options = append([]form.Option{{Value: "", Label: "No digest"}}, base.Options...)
	add("empty-duplicate", empty, expected{Prompt: "Choose cadence"})
	known := base
	known.Value = "weekly"
	add("known", known, expected{Value: "weekly", Submitted: stringPtr("weekly"), Valid: true, Prompt: "Weekly digest"})
	native := base
	native.Value = ""
	native.Required = false
	add("native-default", native, expected{Value: "daily", Submitted: stringPtr("daily"), Valid: true, Prompt: "Daily digest"})
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	gallery.New().ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://127.0.0.1/static/app.css", nil))
	if w.Code != http.StatusOK || w.Body.Len() == 0 {
		panic("actual Gallery CSS unavailable")
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		Cases []specimen `json:"cases"`
		CSS   string     `json:"css"`
	}{cases, w.Body.String()}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
